items.title: More than 12 US military aircraft leave second UK base
items.summary: The departures come weeks after the US withdrew bombers from RAF Fairford airbase over a suspected Iran-linked security incident.

items.title: New information from 'several people' about Russell Brand being assessed by police
items.summary: Several people have contacted police with allegations and information about Russell Brand during his trial and after it concluded.

items.title: Met Police investigating more 'potential criminal allegations' about Brand
items.summary: Det Supt Andy Furphy says the force had received "several reports during the trial and since the trial".

items.title: UK court overturns Trinidad and Tobago law criminalising homosexual sex
items.summary: ‌Trinidad and Tobago's ‌law criminalising consensual sexual ​relations between male same-sex couples has been overturned ‌by a ​UK court.

items.title: Sales of tinned food and bottled water jump after 'Be Ready' campaign launch
items.summary: Sales of essential goods such as hand sanitiser soar after the government called on households to be prepared for emergencies.

items.title: Poundland owner releases £10m to retailer hours before MP grilling
items.summary: Poundland's owner has released millions of pounds of funding to pay the discount retailer's suppliers - a breakthrough in talks about saving the company and its 10,500 staff.
